history.name: A change has to say what it was and why it moved
history.description: An existing feature cannot quietly acquire a new description. Changing one requires the bullets that say what it was before and why it moved — the description already shows a reader what it is now, and the reason is the part only the people who built it know. That reason is what makes the ledger worth reading rather than a diff of a document, and where it isn't known the instruction is to ask for it, never to write a plausible-sounding one into something a client reads.
history.dev_notes: The existedBefore check at the end of cmdUpdate; the refusal text itself carries the rule, so an agent that hits it is told what to supply.
